purpose: Teach: 創り/分別/持ち込ま/金庫/定量/届け出/書式/配管

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新工程、当社で創り上げた技術だ。
lines.en: It's a new process we've built up here from the ground.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause after the dash — pride without performance. Steady eye contact. Clipped consonants on 'built,' letting the accomplishment land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ゴミ、分別徹底、進めています。
lines.en: Yes. We're pushing hard on waste sorting protocols.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Quick nod-tone on 'Yes.' Lean forward slightly. Precise delivery — showing he's tracking each detail. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機密、外部に持ち込ませないように。
lines.en: Make sure nothing confidential leaves the building.
lines.style: Firm instruction, not harsh. Clipped opening. Weight on 'confidential.' Pause for it to register. Still measured — this is policy, not suspicion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。金庫、新型に交換しました。
lines.en: Yes. We've upgraded to a new safe system.
lines.style: Efficient report. Crisp on 'upgraded.' Respectful but not deferential — he's handled it. Brief, factual. Slight sense of satisfaction at completion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 生産、定量で安定させろ。
lines.en: Keep production at consistent output levels.
lines.style: Clear directive. Pause after dash. Emphasis on 'consistent' — this matters. Even pacing. No room for interpretation, but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。届け出書類、関係官庁に提出済みです。
lines.en: Yes. All the required filings have already been submitted to the relevant authorities.
lines.style: Prompt response. Slight quickening — he's prepared. Pride in the detail: 'relevant authorities' lands with quiet competence. No flourish, just done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Terse direction. Clipped pacing. Weight on 'standardize.' No elaboration needed — Kenji understands. Brief, clean.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の配管、保守、定期実施しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're running regular maintenance checks on the factory's piping systems.
lines.style: Steady, thorough. 'Regular maintenance' lands with quiet diligence — he's thinking ahead. No rush. Respectful and complete.
